stem_book: Four vectors A, B, C, D are inclined with respect to the x-axis and y-axis as shown in the figure (A makes 40° with the y-axis, B makes 70° with the x-axis, C makes 30° with the x-axis, D makes 60° with the y-axis). Find the angle between vectors B and D, in degree.
work: B points up-left at 180° − 70° = 110° from +x; D points down-right at 60° from the y-axis, i.e. 30° below +x (−30°) ⇒ angle = 110° − (−30°) = 140°
